title: Derivation of optimal stochastic Runge-Kutta methods with exotic and decorated Butcher series for the weak integration of stochastic dynamics
summary: The design of numerical integrators for solving stochastic dynamics with high weak order relies on tedious calculations and is subject to a high number of order conditions. The original approaches from the literature consider strong approximations and adapt them for the weak approximation by replacing the iterated stochastic integrals by appropriate random variables. The methods obtained this way are sub-optimal in their number of function evaluations and the analysis of order conditions is unnecessarily complicated.
